mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM qc_ledger_goods WHERE deleted = 0) AS goodsTotal, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM qc_supplier WHERE deleted = 0) AS supplierTotal, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM qc_ledger_flow_node WHERE deleted = 0 AND status <> 'NOT_STARTED') AS flowRecordTotal, (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM qc_goods_material gm INNER JOIN qc_material_item mi ON mi.id = gm.item_id AND mi.deleted = 0 AND mi.status = 1 WHERE gm.deleted = 0 AND gm.status IN ('MISSING','PENDING')) AS gapItemTotal
SELECT cooperate_result AS code, COUNT(1) AS value FROM qc_ledger_goods WHERE deleted = 0 GROUP BY cooperate_result ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN g.current_node_code IS NULL OR g.current_node_code = '' THEN '已完成全流程' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(g.current_node_name, ''), g.current_node_code) END AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM qc_ledger_goods g WHERE g.deleted = 0 GROUP BY (CASE WHEN g.current_node_code IS NULL OR g.current_node_code = '' THEN '已完成全流程' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(g.current_node_name, ''), g.current_node_code) END) ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT COALESCE(c1.name, '未分类') AS name, COUNT(1) AS value FROM qc_ledger_goods g LEFT JOIN qc_category c1 ON c1.id = g.category_l1_id AND c1.deleted = 0 WHERE g.deleted = 0 GROUP BY g.category_l1_id, c1.name ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT g.id AS goodsId, g.sku, g.common_name AS commonName, g.brand, c1.name AS categoryL1Name, CASE WHEN g.current_node_code IS NULL OR g.current_node_code = '' THEN '已完成全流程' ELSE g.current_node_name END AS currentNodeName, COUNT(gm.id) AS gapCount, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(gm.item_name, '|', gm.status) ORDER BY mi.sort, mi.id SEPARATOR ';;') AS gapItemsRaw FROM qc_ledger_goods g LEFT JOIN qc_category c1 ON c1.id = g.category_l1_id AND c1.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN qc_goods_material gm ON gm.goods_id = g.id AND gm.deleted = 0 AND gm.status IN ('MISSING','PENDING') INNER JOIN qc_material_item mi ON mi.id = gm.item_id AND mi.deleted = 0 AND mi.status = 1 WHERE g.deleted = 0
AND (g.sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.common_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.brand LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR g.manufacturer LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
GROUP BY g.id, g.sku, g.common_name, g.brand, c1.name, g.current_node_code, g.current_node_name ORDER BY gapCount DESC, g.id DESC

SELECT g.sku, g.common_name AS commonName, c1.name AS categoryL1Name, n.node_sort AS nodeSort, n.node_name AS nodeName, CASE n.status WHEN 'DONE' THEN '已完成' WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN '进行中' WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN '不通过' ELSE '未开始' END AS status, DATE_FORMAT(n.finish_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS finishDate, n.owner_name AS ownerName, s.supplier_name AS supplierName, n.conclusion, n.remark FROM qc_ledger_flow f INNER JOIN qc_ledger_goods g ON g.id = f.goods_id AND g.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN qc_ledger_flow_node n ON n.flow_id = f.id AND n.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN qc_category c1 ON c1.id = g.category_l1_id AND c1.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN qc_supplier s ON s.id = n.supplier_id AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE f.deleted = 0 ORDER BY g.id, n.node_sort, n.id

SELECT g.sku, g.common_name AS commonName, g.brand, c1.name AS categoryL1Name, CASE WHEN g.current_node_code IS NULL OR g.current_node_code = '' THEN '已完成全流程' ELSE g.current_node_name END AS currentNodeName, gm.item_name AS itemName, CASE gm.status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN '待确认' ELSE '缺失' END AS status, gm.remark FROM qc_ledger_goods g LEFT JOIN qc_category c1 ON c1.id = g.category_l1_id AND c1.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN qc_goods_material gm ON gm.goods_id = g.id AND gm.deleted = 0 AND gm.status IN ('MISSING','PENDING') INNER JOIN qc_material_item mi ON mi.id = gm.item_id AND mi.deleted = 0 AND mi.status = 1 WHERE g.deleted = 0 ORDER BY g.id, mi.sort, mi.id
